📦 Setup guide — models and ComfyUI folders
widgets_values:
📦 HOI4 PORTRAIT WORKFLOW — MODEL SETUP

The bundled installer places every file below for you. If you install manually, the workflow looks for these exact filenames:

🖼️  FLUX.2 Klein 9B (distilled — never the base model)
    ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/
    ├── flux-2-klein-9b.safetensors        · full BF16, 18.2 GB (24+ GB VRAM)
    ├── flux-2-klein-9b-fp8.safetensors    · FP8, 9.4 GB (16–20 GB VRAM)
    └── flux-2-klein-9b-Q5_K_M.gguf        · GGUF, 7.0 GB (8–16 GB VRAM)

🧠  Qwen 3 8B text encoder
    ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/qwen_3_8b_fp8mixed.safetensors

🎨  FLUX.2 VAE
    ComfyUI/models/vae/flux2-vae.safetensors

🎭  HOI4 style LoRA — step 2500 (the tuned checkpoint)
    ComfyUI/models/loras/hoi4_portrait_flux2_klein_9b_lora_000002500.safetensors

✨  Adonis restoration LoKrs (optional pass)
    ComfyUI/models/loras/adonis_base.safetensors
    ComfyUI/models/loras/adonis_post.safetensors

🔍  Support models
    ComfyUI/models/upscale_models/RealESRGAN_x2plus.pth
    ComfyUI/models/background_removal/birefnet.safetensors
    ComfyUI/models/detection/face_detection_yunet_2023mar.onnx

The GGUF and FP8 files are smaller variants of the same distilled model; pick the one that fits your VRAM (the installer suggests one for you).

nodes.title: 🎛️ Sampler controls — what steps and CFG do
widgets_values:
🎛️  SAMPLER CONTROLS — WHAT THEY DO

Every generation node is one advanced sampler card. The tuned defaults for this workflow are: CFG 1.0, guidance 1.0, 4 steps, Euler sampler, simple scheduler, denoise 1.0.

• Steps — how many denoising passes run. More steps = more detail but slower generation. The style LoRA is trained for 4 steps; going much higher mostly slows things down.
• CFG — how strongly the model follows your prompt. Higher values apply the HOI4 style more sharply (try 2–3 if you want a stronger look).
• Guidance — FLUX.2's own prompt-following scale. Klein works best at low values (default 1.0).
• Seed — the random source. Change it (or hit randomize) for a different portrait from the same prompt.
• Sampling algorithm — the sampler itself. Euler is the tuned default; advanced users can switch (e.g. euler_ancestral, dpmpp_2m).
• Scheduler — how denoise strength is scheduled across steps. Simple is the FLUX.2 default.

Sampling is LIVE: watch the portrait being constructed in the preview cards while it runs.

nodes.title: ✍️ Prompting guide
widgets_values:
✍️  WHAT TO PROMPT

Keep the default prompt exactly as-is:
    make this portrait hoi4_portrait style

That short phrase already triggers the trained HOI4 look. You can safely append a short description when the model needs help:

• Ethnicity or skin colour — if the skin tone comes out wrong.
• Civilian / military / clerical clothing — if it helps the outfit.
• Age, hair, or facial hair — if the portrait drifts.

Example:
    make this portrait hoi4_portrait style, a middle-aged Irish man with dark hair, wearing a military uniform

Don't describe the game, background, lighting, or rendering — the LoRA handles those.

nodes.title: ✨ Why the restoration pass is worth keeping
widgets_values:
✨ WHY THE RESTORATION PASS IS WORTH KEEPING

Old photos are often blurry, grainy, or sepia. RealESRGAN upscales them first, then the optional Adonis pass (Base → Post) rebuilds skin, hair and eye detail and restores natural colour.

The benefit: the HOI4 style LoRA no longer has to guess colours or invent facial details — it can focus purely on the painted HOI4 look, which gives cleaner, more consistent portraits.

The red toggle is ON by default. Turn it OFF if you prefer the direct ESRGAN result (for example a very clean modern photo that needs no repair).

nodes.title: Adonis Base restoration instructions
widgets_values: uhdmanscale, fully reconstruct this entire image from cellphone quality to professional high resolution color raw quality. Remove halftone dot pattern. Apply descreen filter. Eliminate periodic grid noise. Eliminate repeating noise patterns and artifacts, remove uniform diagonal line texture patterns. Reconstruct low resolution high ISO noise areas with high resolution low ISO noise textures. Apply full detail reconstruction to all areas: background, environment, surfaces, objects, clothing, and foreground elements — render everything sharp, textured, and high fidelity. Subject identity is locked: preserve exact facial geometry and body geometry, eye shape and color, nose and mouth shape, and expression. On skin areas, remove color blotch artifacts, normalize tone uniformity, preserve natural pore and texture detail. On hair and body hair areas, separate smeared color artifacts, restore strand separation and texture. Outside the subject's face, freely reconstruct all texture and sharpness with no restrictions. Deblur and focus correction pass. Infer and reconstruct underlying detail from soft source: sharpen edge definition, recover eye detail, lip definition, and skin texture from motion blur. Output as professional high resolution color camera RAW image. fully reconstruct this entire image from cellphone quality to professional high resolution color raw quality.
